import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0001.png')
# Mask out ceiling (dark), wall (white), floor (around [142, 158, 166])
# Let's see what remains!
hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
b, g, r = img[:,:,0], img[:,:,1], img[:,:,2]

# Ceiling: r < 60, g < 60, b < 60
ceiling = (r < 60) & (g < 60) & (b < 60)
# Wall: r > 240, g > 240, b > 240
wall = (r > 240) & (g > 240) & (b > 240)
# Floor: roughly r in [150, 180], g in [140, 175], b in [130, 160], and low saturation
sat = hsv[:,:,1]
floor = (sat < 30) & (r > 120) & (r < 190) & (g > 120) & (g < 190) & (b > 110) & (b < 180)

other = ~(ceiling | wall | floor)
print('Non-background pixels count:', np.sum(other))

# Label connected components of 'other'
num_labels, labels, stats, centroids = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(other.astype(np.uint8))
print(f'Found {num_labels} components')
for i in range(1, num_labels):
    area = stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]
    if area > 100:
        x, y, w, h = stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_LEFT], stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_TOP], stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_WIDTH], stats[i, cv2.CC_STAT_HEIGHT]
        mean_bgr = img[labels == i].mean(axis=0)
        print(f'Component {i}: area={area}, bbox=({x},{y},{w},{h}), center=({centroids[i][0]:.1f},{centroids[i][1]:.1f}), mean_BGR={mean_bgr.astype(int)}')
"
